facts.fact: Peacock generates more than 15 million hours of ad-supported viewing every day, according to NBCUniversal's own description of the platform.
facts.quote: Peacock generates more than 15 million hours of ad-supported viewing every day

facts.fact: NBCUniversal reports a +36% brand impact lift driven by Peacock versus CTV norms, based on 374 Peacock campaigns from 10/1/24-9/30/25 (its own aggregated data).
facts.quote: +36% brand impact lift driven by Peacock (Peacock vs CTV norms)

facts.fact: NBCUniversal reports a +22% search activity lift driven by Peacock versus CTV norms, based on 83 campaigns and 66 brands from 10/1/24-9/30/25 (its own aggregated data).
facts.quote: +22% search activity lift driven by Peacock (Peacock vs. CTV norms)

facts.fact: NBCUniversal states Peacock ad innovations drive 1.7x higher ROAS than Standard media.
facts.quote: driving 1.7x higher ROAS than Standard media

facts.fact: Per Marketcast data (P18+, 2/17/23-4/27/23), Contextual Pause Ads show 23% higher memorability versus Pause Ad norms.
facts.quote: +23% higher memorability driven by Contextual Pause Ads vs. Pause Ad Norms

facts.fact: Per BrightLine data (advertiser campaigns Oct'24-Sep'25, not Peacock-specific norms), Engagement Ads units with NBCU IP have 114% higher interaction rate than those without.
facts.quote: +114% higher interaction rate in Engagement Ads for units with NBCU IP vs. those without

facts.fact: The Spotlight ad format delivers a brand's ad to all Peacock viewers across all content in the first standard ad break on a chosen day, for 24 hours.
facts.quote: your ad is delivered to all Peacock viewers across all content in the first standard ad break — maximizing reach in premium positioning for 24 hours.

facts.fact: The Mindful Moments ad format is a calm, high-impact :10 brand moment placed at the close of the ad break.
facts.quote: Mindful Moments delivers a calm, high-impact :10 brand moment at the close of the ad break

facts.fact: Brightline Engagement Ad units cannot run programmatically, per the chart notes.
